critic.summary: Harmonically and texturally this arrangement is excellent — chords, melody and density track the energy map very well. The main shortcoming is groove: there is no percussive anchor and the bass pattern is a bit static in the Main, which leaves the pulse feeling loose in a genre that benefits from a subtle, consistent low‑end pulse.

issues.problem: Bass plays long roots (sustains of ~3 beats) with a short passing tone only on beat 4, producing a static feel that doesn't tightly lock with the suggested percussive pulse.
issues.fix: In bars 5–12, shorten the long root sustains to land on beat 1 and release around beat 3 (e.g., change E2@1(3) -> E2@1(2)), then place the passing tone slightly before the downbeat (e.g., move the short passing tone from beat 4 to beat 3.5 or 3) to create forward motion and line up with the drums' offbeat. Introduce occasional root+octave hits on beat 3 of bars 7 and 9 to increase Main energy and help lock with the kick.

critic.summary: Beautifully voiced harmonies and a well-developed, airy melody — harmonic fit, section variation and instrumental balance are strong. The main shortcoming is rhythmic glue: there is no dedicated drum part, so the groove feels loose in the Main section even though the bass places roots on the downbeat. Add a subtle, genre-appropriate percussion bed to anchor the pulse without disturbing the ambient spaciousness.
